LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_BriefPonyt: A short, sleek cap of hair sweeps back close to the head with a smooth top, ending in a small gathered tail that flicks out low at the back of the neck. There is no fringe across the forehead, and the sides stay tight against the head. The overall silhouette is compact and low-volume, reading as a tidy, minimal ponytail rather than a long sweep.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Princess: Hair parts down the center at the crown into two rounded, slightly puffed sections that frame the face, then descends into two long, thick lengths falling well past the shoulders on either side. The strands hang straight and heavy with a gentle inward curve near the ends. The look is symmetric and full at the top, long and curtain-like below, giving a regal, framed-face shape.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Scatman: This is a thin, ring-like band of hair that traces only the outer edge of the head, leaving the entire top and crown bare in the middle. The hair sits low and narrow around the sides and back, like a horseshoe fringe of growth circling a bald dome. The silhouette is open and hollow at the center, emphasizing a receded, balding crown.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Lackland: A single sweeping mass of hair curves across the head from one side, full and rounded at the top and tapering to a pointed wisp at the lower front, like a windswept side-swept style. Most of the volume gathers on one side with a long curving sideburn-like point reaching down toward the jaw. The shape is asymmetric and flowing, weighted to one side with a clean curved outline.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Revolt: Hair forms one bold, angular wedge that rises high and sweeps to a peaked point at the top, then slopes down in a long diagonal toward one side. The mass is solid and blocky with a sharp leading edge, like a steep swept-up style frozen in motion. The silhouette is asymmetric and dramatic, tall on one side and tapering low on the other.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Pigtails: The hair sits in two rounded, puffed bunches, one on each side of the head, with a small dip in the middle at the top between them. Each side bulges outward into a soft horn-like shape, and a short central section hangs down low in the middle. The look is clearly symmetric and split into two side bunches, compact rather than long.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Afro: A wide, rounded dome of dense, voluminous hair puffs out evenly around the head with a soft cloud-like outline. There is a slight central notch at the very top, and the mass curves down past the ears on both sides with a textured, full body. The silhouette is broad, symmetric, and bushy, reading as thick natural volume all around.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Bob: A rounded, full cap of hair covers the crown and sweeps down to about ear or jaw level, with a slight swirl of volume across the top. The sides drop straight and end in a clean blunt line, leaving the lower face open between two framing sections. The shape is neat, symmetric, and chin-length, the classic rounded bob outline.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Burgundy: A smooth, rounded helmet of hair caps the head and curves down past the ears, with a small swirl of volume worked into the top front. The sides come down and tuck in with a slight flick near the bottom, framing the face in a short, contained shape. The overall silhouette is tidy and rounded, sitting around ear to jaw length with no long lengths.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Troubadour: Hair sits as a rounded, padded shape across the top with a soft dip in the center, giving two gentle lobes at the crown. The sides angle downward and outward in textured, fanning strands that flare a little past the ears. The look is symmetric and medium-short, full on top with flicked-out lower sides.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_GreasySwoo: The hair sweeps up and around into a prominent rolled curl or swoop at the front center, almost forming a loop above the brow, like a slicked pompadour wave. From this central roll the mass spreads outward to both sides and tapers into pointed wisps near the ears. The silhouette is symmetric with a bold central twist, low and tapered at the sides.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Cleopatra: A smooth, rounded dome of hair covers the crown and falls straight down on both sides into two heavy, blunt lengths that frame the face and reach toward the shoulders. There is no part or fringe disruption across the top, just a clean curved hairline. The shape is symmetric and sleek, two straight curtains hanging from a rounded top.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Cute: The top of the head carries two rounded buns or puffs side by side at the crown, with a small notch between them. Below, the hair flares out into short, textured sides that flick outward near the ears and end with a few pointed tips. The look is symmetric, playful, and short, combining twin top knots with a flicked-out lower fringe.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Decent: Hair is parted in the middle at the top and falls down both sides in long, smooth lengths that drape past the shoulders. The strands hang straight and close to the face with a slight inward taper at the ends, leaving the center of the face open. The silhouette is symmetric, long, and simple, a clean center-parted curtain style.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_FancyBun: The hair is pulled up into a rounded bun perched high at the back of the crown, with the main mass sitting smooth and boxy at the back of the head. From the lower sides, two twisted braids descend, coiling down past where the shoulders would be. The look combines a neat top bun with long spiraling braids on each side, mostly symmetric.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Senorita: A smooth, rounded cap of hair covers the head and rises to a small topknot or bun at the crown. The lower edge has a gentle scalloped fringe across the forehead, and two thin twisted braids drop down from the sides. The silhouette is rounded and tidy on top with a small bun and slender braided strands hanging at the sides.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Flowy: Hair rises in a softly peaked, rounded crown that dips slightly in the center, then sweeps down both sides into long, smooth lengths that fall past the shoulders. The sides are full and curtain-like, flaring gently outward at the bottom. The shape is symmetric and flowing, voluminous up top with long draping sides framing an open face.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Long: A rounded, full cap of hair sits high on the crown and parts toward the center, then falls down both sides into medium lengths that taper to soft points near the jaw and shoulders. The top is voluminous and slightly peaked, with the sides curving inward at the ends. The silhouette is symmetric, full above and gently tapering below into face-framing lengths.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Mop: A thick, shaggy mop of medium length that sits full and rounded over the head. It covers the crown and ears completely and falls to a slightly uneven, jagged fringe across the forehead that is broken by a small notch near the center. The overall shape is bushy and bowl-like, fuller at the sides than a tidy cut, flaring out a little above the ears.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Wavy: A medium-length style that frames the face, fullest at the crown and curving down past the ears on both sides where it ends in soft inward-curling tips near jaw level. The top is rounded and voluminous with a gently dipped center, and the overall silhouette is balanced and symmetric. The forehead is left open beneath an arched top edge, and the texture reads as soft and wavy rather than sleek or spiky.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Messy: A short, rounded cap of hair that arches high over the head and sweeps down just past the ears on each side. The surface is broken into uneven jagged strands and flicks rather than a smooth edge, giving a tousled, untidy look. It covers the top and sides while leaving the lower face open, and the volume sits mostly across the crown.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Curly: A medium bob that puffs out at the crown and falls to about jaw level on both sides, ending in rounded inward curls. The top edge dips slightly at the center parting and the sides flare outward with soft bulk. The overall shape is full, rounded, and symmetric with a thick, springy texture.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Fringe: A short rounded style that caps the head and angles forward, with the right side longer and swept down past the cheek while the left side is shorter near the ear. A heavy diagonal fringe sweeps across the brow. The silhouette is asymmetric, smooth, and close to the head with most of the length concentrated on one side.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Frozen: A short style that wraps around the head and sides in a thick, slightly chunky band that dips low at the center of the brow. It covers the crown and the sides down to around ear level, with a blocky, stiff-looking edge rather than soft strands. The forehead is partly covered by a low central point, and the shape is compact and rounded.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Ponytails: Two pigtails worn one on each side, each tied near the temple and hanging down and outward to about jaw level before tapering to a point. The top of the head is rounded and parted at the center, with a small lift of hair above the tie on each side. The look is symmetric and playful, framing an open face between the two tails.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Bowlcut: A classic bowl cut that sits as a single smooth, rounded dome capping the top of the head. It ends in a clean, even horizontal line across the brow and just above the ears, with a tiny notch dipping at the center. The silhouette is simple, blunt, and symmetric with no visible parting or stray strands.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Bravo: A short, neat style that rounds smoothly over the crown and tapers down the sides past the ears, ending in small flicks near the jaw. The top is slightly raised and full while the sides stay close to the head. The overall shape is tidy, compact, and roughly symmetric with a clean edge.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Recruit: A very short, close-cropped style shaped like a low crescent that hugs the top and back of the head. It is thickest across the crown and curves down to a notch at the lower front, leaving the face fully open. The look is minimal and sleek with almost no length on the sides.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Rockstar: A medium swept style with volume at the crown and hair brushed back and to one side in long flowing strands. The right side sweeps down past the ear while the left stays shorter and tucked, giving an asymmetric, windblown look. The texture is smooth with visible diagonal flow lines running back from the brow.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Snazzy: A long, voluminous style parted sharply down the center, with two full curtains of hair falling on either side past jaw level and curling outward at the tips. The crown is high and rounded and the center part is clearly defined. The face is left open between the two thick, symmetric side sweeps, giving a glamorous, flowing look.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Firestarte: A dramatic style that flares out into two large wing-like points sweeping up and outward from a lower center, resembling spread horns or wings. The center dips into a small peaked notch while the two sides rise into bold pointed tips. The silhouette is wide, angular, sharply symmetric, and aggressive rather than soft.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Junkie: A short, spiky style that caps the head with a fringe of downward-pointing jagged strands all around the brow and sides. The crown is rounded and the lower edge breaks into several pointed tongues, including a central spike over the forehead. The look is ragged and bristly, framing the face with uneven points.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Scrapper: An asymmetric style with all the length swept to one side, rising in a peaked flick at the top and cascading down the right side in long, loose strands that taper to ragged points near the shoulder. The opposite side is short and close to the head. The silhouette is bold and lopsided with a flowing, windswept drape on the one side.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Randy: A wild, shaggy style of thick layered strands that all sweep diagonally in the same direction, breaking into several jagged pointed tips along the lower edge. The mass is full and irregular with a feathered, untamed texture. The overall shape is chunky and angular, like ragged hair blown to one side.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Rookie: A very short, close style that leaves a small narrow rounded patch of hair centered on the top of the head, with faint short wisps sweeping back low at the sides. Most of the head reads as nearly bare with only this slim central cap of hair standing out. The look is minimal, sparse, and symmetric.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Spikes: A single tall, narrow spike that rises straight up from the head into a sharp point, far taller than it is wide. The form is thin and triangular, tapering steadily from a small base to a fine tip. The look is bold and minimal, like one dramatic upright horn of hair.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_ShaveTopBr: A style with the sides and back shaved close, leaving a single rounded patch or knot of hair sitting on the very top of the crown like a small cap. The rest of the head reads as bare around it, so the hair forms one compact circular mass up top. The silhouette is clean and minimal with all volume concentrated in the central topknot.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_BraidedKno: A crescent band of hair arched across the top of the head, its surface divided into many thin vertical segments that read as a row of small braids or twists. It is thickest at the crown and tapers to points at both ends near the temples, leaving the face open below. The texture is strongly ridged and regular, like tightly arranged braided strands.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Keeper: A short, rounded cap of hair that frames the face and tapers down past the ears on both sides into soft points near the jaw. The top is full and smooth with a gentle center dip in the fringe across the brow. It sits close to the head with modest volume and a symmetric, helmet-like silhouette that leaves the lower face open.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Primal: A small skullcap of hair sitting high and tight on the very top of the head, leaving the sides and back of the scalp bare and exposed. The covered patch is a compact oval crown with a heavy outlined rim, almost like a close-cropped tonsure. The overall coverage is minimal, with the bulk of the head shaved or bald around a single rounded tuft up top.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Warden: A swept, side-parted style with the bulk of the hair brushed to one side and falling in a smooth wing down past the cheek. A long pointed lock curls forward at the brow while a smaller flick lifts up and back at the crown, giving an asymmetric, windblown look. One side has volume and length to the jaw while the other side stays short and tucked.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Elder: Two long, narrow side locks that hang straight down beside the face like a pair of slim sideburns or temple strands, with the entire crown and top of the head left bare. Each strand is a thin vertical sliver that curves gently inward toward the chin. The look is sparse and strongly symmetric, just two dangling pieces and no top coverage.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Locks: A full, shoulder-skimming style parted softly down the center with a wispy, slightly tousled crown. The hair sweeps outward and down on both sides, flaring into rounded tails that point outward near the jaw and lower neck. It has gentle volume and a loose, layered texture with a roughly symmetric shape.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Savage: A single thick, curved hank of hair shaped like a comma or curled horn, fuller at the top and tapering to a point at the bottom. It sweeps from a rounded crown down and around to one side in one bold sculpted curl. The form is asymmetric and chunky, suggesting a wild swept-back fin rather than even coverage.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Sticky: A loose, mane-like style with a high tousled crown that dips in a soft V over the forehead and frames the face on both sides. The hair falls in thick, slightly ragged layers down to about the jaw, flaring out at the ends with a windswept, untidy texture. It is roughly symmetric with noticeable volume around the temples.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Shaved: A bare, smooth scalp with no hair coverage at all, shown only as the faint rounded outline of the bald head. There is no fringe, no sides, and no volume anywhere. The silhouette is a clean, hairless dome.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Tuft: A small, spiky burst of hair clustered at the very top of the head, with short jagged points radiating out in a star-like crest. The covered area is tiny and irregular, leaving the rest of the scalp bare. The texture reads as stiff and bristly, a little spiked patch rather than a full hairstyle.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_ScorpionTa: A rounded cap of hair over the crown that gathers into a long segmented tail at the back. From the side the tail is unmistakable, a row of bulbous bead-like segments that arcs downward and curls forward like a scorpion tail before tapering to a point. The front and top sit close and smooth, so all of the length and drama is carried in that distinctive curving tail behind the head.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Topdog: A short, close-fitting cap of hair that covers the top and crown and ends in a jagged, scalloped fringe along the bottom edge. The lower border breaks into several downward points or tufts across the brow and temples. It sits snug to the head with little side length, giving a broad rounded top and a ragged hairline.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Mohawk: A tall, narrow strip of hair running straight up the center of the head, with the sides completely bare and shaved. The central band is a clean upright rectangle of volume rising well above the scalp. The shape is strongly symmetric, just one bold vertical crest down the middle.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Artist: A wide, rounded bowl of hair that sweeps low over the brow and curves around the sides, with a small notched gap cut out at the center of the fringe like a parted curtain. The overall outline is broad and oval, hugging the upper head. The bottom edge dips down on either side of the central split, framing the forehead.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Mary: A center-parted style that arcs over the crown and sweeps down on both sides into full, rounded volume around the cheeks and jaw. The two side masses curl forward and inward, leaving the lower face open in a horseshoe shape. It is symmetric and bouncy, with the fullness concentrated at the sides rather than the top.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Anne: A rounded updo with a neat bun or knot gathered high on the crown, sitting atop a fuller body of hair that curves down and around the face. The lower hair forms a soft horseshoe framing the cheeks, ending in small flicks near the jaw on both sides. The look is symmetric and tidy, topped by the distinct raised bun.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Elisabeth: A tall, dome-shaped style with stacked, tiered ridges rising in rounded bands toward a point at the crown, like a layered beehive. Below, the hair drops down past the ears on both sides into long tapering side pieces that frame the face. The silhouette is symmetric with a notable peaked, sculpted top and a deep center scoop over the brow.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Jane: A voluminous style with a high, puffed crown that swells into two soft rounded lobes split by a center part. The hair sweeps down and outward on both sides, ending in short flicks near the jaw and leaving a curved gap over the lower face. It is bushy and symmetric with most of the volume gathered up top.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Lisa: A center-parted style that arches smoothly over the crown and drops into two thick braided coils, one hanging beside each cheek. Each side piece has a ribbed, twisted texture suggesting a plait or rope braid that tapers toward the jaw. The look is symmetric and ornamental, with the braids framing the open face.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Victoria: A high topknot or bun sits on the crown above hair that fans out wide and falls in long, sweeping curtains down past the shoulders on both sides. The lower hair flares outward into pointed tails, giving a broad, draping silhouette. It is roughly symmetric with a lot of length and a smooth, flowing texture beneath the gathered knot.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Henry: A rounded helmet of hair that caps the crown and curves smoothly down past both ears to about jaw level, framing the face in a neat dome. The bottom edge on each side terminates in a small rounded curl or bead, almost like a short rolled tip beside the cheeks. The overall look is short to medium, even and symmetric, with a smooth straight texture and no visible parting or fringe. It reads as a tidy, full-coverage cut hugging the head.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Richard: A short, rounded cap of hair sitting high on the head with a softly scalloped lower edge that dips in gentle waves across the forehead. At each side, near the ears, the hair pinches into a small rounded curl that juts outward like a little tuft. The style is compact and symmetric, covering the crown without reaching the shoulders, with a smooth straight texture. It gives a neat, slightly puffed bowl-like silhouette.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Stephen: A thin crescent or horseshoe of hair that rings the upper head and arcs down each side, leaving the center of the crown open. The band is narrow and even, sweeping from one side around the top to the other in a smooth U-shape that frames a bare middle. It is short and close to the head with no fringe, ponytail, or volume. The effect resembles a receded or ring-shaped hairline rather than a full head of hair.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_William: A short, rounded cap covering the crown with a smooth domed top, ending in a softly curved lower edge that frames the upper face. Fine vertical lines comb down from the crown suggesting straight, sleek strands falling forward. The sides curve down just past the ears in a symmetric arc, with no parting and no fringe of note. It is a tidy, close, medium-short bowl-like cut.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_DoubleTuft: Two separate jagged tufts of hair stand up from the top of the head, each shaped like a rough star or splayed clump with several pointed prongs. They sit side by side, splaying outward and upward, with a small gap between them in the center. The texture is spiky and irregular rather than smooth, giving a wild, messy crown. The rest of the head appears bare, so the volume is concentrated entirely in these two upright spiky clusters.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_LargeTuft: A single large, swept clump of hair sits on one side of the head, shaped like a windblown flame or comma that sweeps up and over to a pointed tip. The lower edge has a small jagged notch, and the mass tapers as it curls toward the back. It is asymmetric, concentrated to one side, with a smooth but pointed silhouette. The effect is a bold, sweeping forelock or quiff rather than even coverage.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_LongMess: A shaggy, medium-length mop that falls down around the head in ragged, uneven points reaching toward the jaw and lower. The lower edge breaks into several pointed, spiky tendrils of differing lengths, giving a tousled, unkempt look. It is fuller at the crown and parts roughly in the middle, with no neat styling. The overall silhouette is wild and messy with jagged, layered ends.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_LongOily: Long, lank hair parted in the center at the top and hanging straight down both sides of the face in two heavy curtains. The strands fall well past the jaw with limp, flat tendrils that taper to points, framing an open bare space in the middle where the face would be. The texture is slick and stringy rather than voluminous, lying close and weighted down. The silhouette is symmetric, with two long drooping side panels and a clear central part.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Parted: Two distinct side panels of hair frame the face, one on each side, with a clear empty gap between them where the center parting falls. Each panel sweeps down past the cheek and tapers to a pointed tip near the jaw, the right side longer and fuller than the left. The strands are smooth and slightly curved, angling inward toward the bottom. The look is a deep center part with two swept, tapering curtains of medium length.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_PatchyShav: The head is nearly bare with only sparse, irregular patches of very short stubble clinging to the crown. A few thin uneven streaks of remaining hair scatter across the top with no clear pattern, leaving most of the scalp shorn. There is no length, fringe, or volume anywhere. The impression is of a roughly and incompletely shaved head with stray patches left behind.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_RoughShave: A very short, close-cropped band of stubble caps the top of the head, low and flat with almost no height. The lower edge is rough and uneven, broken by small jagged notches across the forehead and sides. There is no length, parting, or volume, just a thin even layer of buzzed hair hugging the scalp. The silhouette is a low, slightly ragged cap of shaved-down growth.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_ShavedMoha: A broad, flat band of very short hair runs across the top of the head, wider than a typical narrow strip and squared off at the sides. The sides below appear shaved close, leaving a low, blocky cap of stubble on the crown. There is no length or upright spiking, just a flat shorn shape. The form reads as a wide, buzzed-down mohawk or central pad with cleared sides.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_ShortCut: A short, rounded cap of hair covering the crown with a smooth domed top and a softly scalloped lower edge that dips slightly over the forehead. The sides curve down to about ear level and end cleanly, framing the face without reaching the jaw. There is no parting, ponytail, or fringe of note, just even close coverage. The silhouette is a tidy, compact bowl-style cut.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_SideCut: A single swept mass of hair sits on one side of the head, curving up at the top and sweeping down the side to a pointed tip near the jaw. The opposite side appears shaved or bare, leaving the volume entirely asymmetric and gathered to one side. The upper edge has a small notch where it lifts, and the strands angle in a smooth diagonal sweep. The effect is a long side-swept lock paired with a cleared, shaved-down opposite side.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_SideSpikes: A bold, jagged clump of hair sweeps across one side of the head, splaying out into several sharp pointed spikes that jut outward and upward. The mass angles diagonally with a spiky, star-like edge at the top and a tapering hooked tail at the bottom. It is concentrated to one side and asymmetric, with an aggressive, windswept spiky texture. The silhouette is wild and pointed rather than smooth.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Ghoul_Furi: Two upright, ragged shards of hair rise from the sides of the head, each shaped like a curved blade or talon that sweeps up and inward. The left clump is shorter with a small notch, the right taller and broader, both pointed at the tips. They flank an empty center, giving a wild, horn-like or flared appearance. The texture is jagged and bladed, suggesting an agitated, feral look.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Ghoul_Hung: A single curved, claw-like clump of hair hangs on one side of the head, hooking downward to a pointed tip like a fang or talon. It is solid and smooth-edged with a slight inward curl, concentrated entirely on one side while the rest is bare. The shape is sparse and asymmetric, lacking any full coverage or volume. The impression is a lone hooked lock, gaunt and minimal.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Ghoul_Rave: Two separate curved shards of hair sit apart on either side, each shaped like a jagged hook or fang, the left one notched and pointing down, the right a longer crescent sweeping outward. They do not meet, leaving a wide bare gap across the head. The forms are sparse, asymmetric, and bladed with pointed tips. The look is feral and thin, like scattered tufts clinging to a mostly bald head.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Ghoul_Twis: Two twisted, talon-like locks of hair rise on either side of the head, each curling and hooking with notched, irregular edges that suggest gnarled growth. The left tapers down to a thin point while the right is broader with a small upper notch, both flanking an empty center. The texture is wrenched and jagged rather than smooth, giving a contorted, feral silhouette. The effect is two warped horn-like clumps with a bare gap between them.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Ghoul_Veng: Two separate curved tufts of hair frame an otherwise bare head, one on each side, with nothing across the top or middle. Each tuft is a thick, hook-like sliver that sweeps down and inward like a curved fang or claw, tapering to a point. The left and right pieces roughly mirror each other but stay short and sparse, sitting around ear level. The look is ragged and minimal, more like clinging side-locks than a full head of hair.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Ghoul_Warp: Hair appears only as two jagged clumps on the sides of the head, leaving the crown completely bare. Each clump is broad and feathered at the top and breaks into several pointed, spiky strands that hang straight down past the jaw. The strands look torn and uneven, like wind-blasted tufts rather than groomed locks. The two sides are loosely symmetric, framing the face with sharp, splintered points.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Hair_Ghoul_Wick: Two long, sickle-shaped locks hang down the sides of the head while the top stays bare. The left lock is a smooth, tapering crescent that curves gently inward to a point. The right lock is heavier and more ragged at the top, with a small notched flick before sweeping down into a long curved blade-like tip. The pair frames the face asymmetrically, giving a sharp, hook-like silhouette.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Anchor: This beard sits low and wide like the flukes of a ship's anchor. A small mustache patch rides just under the nose, and below a bare gap the beard spreads into a broad shape whose two lower corners curl up and outward into sharp points. The jawline edges are clean and the chin region is filled solid. The upturned tips on either side give it a distinct anchor or crescent silhouette.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Bushy: A large, full beard that covers the cheeks, jaw, and chin in one dense mass. The top corners rise into two pointed peaks near the ears, and the sides flare outward before tapering to a wide, slightly ragged bottom edge. A mustache arches across the upper lip with the mouth left open beneath it. Overall it reads as thick, voluminous, and rounded, broad at the cheeks and heavy along the jaw.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Norse: A thick, sculpted full beard divided into stacked rounded sections that look braided or clumped into ropes. Two pointed tufts rise at the upper sides near the ears, and the central mass bulges into a heavy rounded chin piece. Curved seams separate the bundles, giving a layered, woven texture. The whole shape is dense and symmetrical with a broad, blocky build.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Boxed: A neatly bordered beard that outlines the jaw and chin while leaving the mouth area open. The cheek lines climb to two upward-flicked points at the top sides, and the lower edge curves into a rounded, slightly squared bottom. The interior is hollowed around the lips so the chin and jaw frame is emphasized. It looks trim and defined rather than bushy, with sharp flared tips.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Circle: A compact oval ring of beard that encircles the mouth, like a rounded frame around the lips. The outer edge is a smooth horizontal oval and the center is open where the mouth sits. The band is fairly even in thickness all the way around. It reads as a tidy, closed circle-beard hugging just the chin and mouth without spreading onto the cheeks.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_BeardCurl: A full, rounded beard that covers the jaw and chin in a soft, billowing mass. A mustache arches over the open mouth, and below it the beard puffs outward and down into a wide, scalloped lower edge made of several rounded lobes. The bottom looks bumpy and curly rather than straight-cut. The overall silhouette is broad, plush, and gently rounded.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Curtain: A thin, open beard that runs along the jawline like a hanging curtain with no fill in the middle. The two sides sweep down and meet at the chin, where a small notch or tuft dips at the center bottom. The cheeks and area below the lip are left bare, leaving just a curved outline. The effect is a sparse U-shaped fringe framing the lower face.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_BushyStyl: A large full beard groomed into a smoother, more shaped mass than a wild bushy one. Two pointed tufts rise at the top sides near the ears, and a soft mustache and central seam run down the middle to a rounded chin. The sides taper inward neatly toward the bottom. It looks dense and voluminous but combed and tidy, with a clear central part.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Ducktail: A medium beard that gathers the jaw and chin into a single tapered point at the bottom, like a duck's tail. The upper corners flick up slightly at the sides, a small mustache sits under the nose, and the mass narrows smoothly to a rounded tip at the chin. The cheeks are lightly covered and the shape stays compact. The silhouette is wider at the jaw and pointed below.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_StacheAnd: This style pairs a curved mustache with two separate sideburn chops and leaves the chin bare. A wavy mustache spans the upper lip in the center, and on each side a thick, pointed muttonchop runs down the cheek and flicks outward at the bottom. There is a clear gap between the mustache and the chops, and no hair on the chin itself. The arrangement is symmetric and bold, framing an open lower face.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Fork: A full beard whose bottom splits into two prongs like a fork or a forked tail. The upper sides rise to pointed tips near the ears and a mustache arches over the mouth, while the main mass narrows downward and divides into a central V notch at the chin. The overall shape is broad at the top and pointed at the two lower tines. It is dense and symmetric with a distinctive split bottom.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_French: A pointed chin beard topped by a wide, drooping mustache that fans out across the upper lip. Below the mustache the beard narrows into a solid triangular wedge that comes to a point at the bottom of the chin. The cheeks are bare, putting the focus on the broad mustache and the tapering goatee shape. It reads as a classic musketeer-style pointed beard.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Full: A wide beard that frames the jaw with two upturned points at the outer sides and a hollow open center around the mouth. The lower edge curves smoothly between the two flared tips, and a slight rise sits at the chin. The interior around the lips is left open so only the jaw outline is filled. The shape is broad and horizontal with sharp upward corners.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Goatee: A simple chin beard shaped like a rounded inverted triangle with no mustache. It is widest across the top under the lip and tapers smoothly to a soft point at the bottom of the chin. The cheeks and upper lip are completely bare. The patch is solid, compact, and centered on the chin.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Classy: A handlebar mustache paired with a pointed chin goatee. The mustache is broad and curls upward at both ends into raised tips, and below a small gap the chin beard forms a solid downward-pointing triangle. The cheeks are bare so the two elements stand apart cleanly. The look is dapper and symmetric, with the curled stache as its signature.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Braided: A narrow, sculpted beard built around an open mouth ring at the top that gathers into a single long braid hanging straight down. The upper portion forms a small oval frame around the lips, then the beard twists into a roped, knotted strand that descends well below the chin. The braid has bumps and kinks suggesting woven sections. It is thin and vertical overall, dominated by the one long plaited tail.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Lincoln: A chin curtain that frames the jawline with no mustache at all. The beard runs along both sides of the jaw and meets under the chin in a soft U-shape, leaving the entire area above the lip and around the mouth completely bare. It is short and close-cropped, hugging the jaw rather than hanging down. The overall look is a clean, symmetric outline tracing the lower face.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_LongDutch: A full beard that covers the jaw and chin and rises into two pointed tufts at the cheeks, giving it a horned silhouette at the top corners. A mustache arches across the upper lip and connects down into the beard, with a small notch left open just below the lower lip. The chin hangs in a broad, blunt mass with faint vertical strands suggesting some length. The shape is symmetric and bushy, wider at the cheeks than at the chin.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Machete: A wide handlebar-style mustache with no beard. It sweeps broadly across the upper lip and curls upward at both ends into long sharp points. The body is fairly thick and flat in the middle, then tapers as it rises toward the tips. The whole shape is symmetric and spans well past the corners of the mouth.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Moustache: A simple, modest mustache sitting on the upper lip with no beard. It is a low, flattened oval that dips slightly at the center and tapers gently toward each side without curling. The form is thin to medium in thickness and stays close to the lip line. The silhouette is understated and symmetric.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_MuttonCho: Bushy side whiskers that flare out from each cheek into upward-curling points, connected across the upper lip by a mustache. The jaw is left bare in the middle so the chin shows through an open gap beneath the mustache. Each side sweeps down and then hooks upward, giving a pair of horn-like flares framing the face. The shape is bold and symmetric with empty space at the chin.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_TriBraid: A braided beard that splits into three thick plaited sections. A central braid hangs straight down from the chin, flanked by two outer braids that swing out to the sides near the ears. The strands show clear woven texture and the whole arrangement is broad at the top and divided below. The look is heavy, structured, and symmetric.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_OldDutch: A jaw-hugging beard with no mustache, the area above the lip left bare. It runs along both sides of the jaw and rises into two sharp upward points at the cheeks, dipping into a shallow V under the chin. The body is short and close to the face rather than long or hanging. The silhouette is angular and symmetric with pointed top corners.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Seer: A long, rounded beard that comes to a soft point at the bottom, framed by an outlined border that traces its edge. It covers the chin and jaw fully and tapers from a wide top down to a gentle teardrop tip. The surface is smooth with a defining outline running just inside the perimeter. The overall form is full, symmetric, and heart-like in outline.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_SideWhisk: Two narrow vertical strips of whiskers, one running down in front of each ear, with nothing connecting them across the chin or lip. Each strip is a slim, slightly curved sliver that follows the line of the cheek down toward the jaw. The center of the face is entirely bare. The look is minimal and symmetric, just a pair of thin sideburns.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_SoulPatch: A tiny patch of hair centered just below the lower lip, with no other facial hair. It reads as a small rounded square sitting on the chin. There is no mustache and the jaw is bare. The shape is compact, isolated, and centered.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Stubble: Light, even stubble spread thinly across the lower face. It traces the jaw and chin and a faint mustache line, with the lips left open and bare in the middle. The coverage is sparse and soft-edged rather than a solid mass. The overall impression is a faint, symmetric shadow of growth.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Urist: A full, rounded beard covering the jaw and chin, topped by a thick mustache that arches over the lip and tucks into the beard below. The chin portion hangs in a broad, blunt curve with a faintly outlined seam separating the mustache from the lower beard. The body is dense and slightly bushy, widest at the jaw. The silhouette is solid and symmetric with a smooth lower edge.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_VanDyke: A pointed beard confined to the chin paired with a separate mustache, leaving the jawline along the cheeks mostly bare. Two small upward points rise at the upper cheeks while the main mass narrows to a chin tuft. A mustache arches across the lip and meets the chin beard. The look is neat and symmetric, concentrated at the center of the lower face.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_Wizard: A very long, full beard that covers the cheeks, jaw, and chin and hangs in a heavy rounded mass. Small pointed tufts rise at the upper cheeks while a flat mustache line crosses just under the nose. The lower portion bulges outward and droops, fuller and longer than a standard beard. The shape is broad, dense, and symmetric.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_FurskinCu: A broad mushroom-shaped arrangement: a wide curling mustache spreads across the top, with a tapering tuft of beard hanging from the chin below it. The mustache forms a thick rounded canopy with a thin highlighted seam along its lip line, and the chin piece narrows to a point. The two parts together read like a cap over a stem. The form is bold, rounded, and symmetric.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Beard_BeardFurs: A dense full beard textured with rounded, knotted lumps across its surface like clustered knots or matted tufts. It covers the whole jaw and chin and rises into two pointed peaks at the upper cheeks. The bumpy interior gives it a lumpy, woven appearance rather than a smooth sweep. The silhouette is broad, heavy, and symmetric with horned top corners.

A wide beard that gathers into one massive central braid hanging straight down below the chin. The upper portion fans out broadly across the jaw with flowing strands, then funnels into a thick segmented plait at the bottom. The big braid is clearly banded into stacked sections. The overall shape is wide at top, narrowing to a heavy single tail, and symmetric.

A beard that frames the lower face along the jaw and leaves the chin center open in a small notch, with no full chin coverage. Each side sweeps up from a low point into a raised tuft near the cheek, curving like a pair of wings. The center stays hollow so the chin shows through. The shape is curved, symmetric, and open in the middle.

A large drooping mustache with no beard, shaped like an upside-down U. It rises in a small peak under the nose then sweeps down on both sides into long thick arms that hang well past the corners of the mouth. The center is open so the chin and lower lip show through. The form is heavy, symmetric, and elongated downward.

A short, full beard that wraps the whole lower face from sideburn to sideburn, covering the jaw and chin without much length. The lower edge is broken into a row of small jagged points, giving a rough, unkempt scruffy texture rather than a clean line. Small tufts rise up past the cheeks on each side, and the overall mass is rounded and close to the face. The mustache region merges seamlessly into the cheek growth so there is no bare gap.

A long beard that hangs straight down from the jaw in two heavy side panels with a noticeable notch dipping in the center, forming a soft W along the bottom. The growth climbs high up the cheeks into upward tufts on either side, framing the face widely. The center of the chin shows an inner arch so the beard reads as parted or split down the middle. It is long and full overall, sitting away from a tidy line and giving a shaggy, drooping look.

Two separate vertical strips of facial hair sit only along the sides, running down in front of each ear like long mutton chops with no growth across the chin or mustache between them. Each chop is tall and slightly curved, wider at the cheek and tapering to a point toward the jaw, with a ragged inner edge. The middle of the face is completely bare, so the two pieces stay distinctly apart. The effect is bold side whiskers without a connecting beard.

A thin beard that traces only the lower jawline as a narrow curved band sweeping from one side to the other, leaving the chin area shallow and open in the center. At each end the band flares up into a small pointed tuft beside the cheek. There is little length and no chin mass, so it reads as a light fringe outlining the jaw rather than a full beard. The shape is symmetric and low, hugging the bottom edge of the face.

A bold horseshoe-shaped beard that covers both cheeks and sweeps fully down the sides of the jaw, leaving a wide bare gap under the chin in the center. Each side rises into a thick upward-curving tuft near the cheekbone and the growth is heavy and broad, not thin. The two sides connect across the upper cheeks but open into a U beneath, so the chin point shows through. Overall it is a strong, full set of chops with substantial volume.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Tig: An asymmetric face design built from bold curved sweeps that resemble a stylized creature or claw mark. An upper element forms a hook or talon shape near the brow and cheek on one side, with a sharp tapering stroke flicking outward to the side. Below sits a separate curved fin-like or fish-tail stroke lower on the face. The strokes are thick, dynamic, and uneven left to right, giving a wild slashing look.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Cob: A spiderweb design spread across one side of the face. It fills a roughly triangular area anchored in a corner of the face and fanning outward, formed from the radiating spokes and looping strands of a cobweb rather than a solid block. The effect is a fine, linear web stretched over the cheek and temple.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Ecl: A single bold solid shape covering the upper face like a wide dome or half-disc, flat along the bottom and gently rounded over the top. It spreads broadly across the brow and forehead region, filling that whole band as one heavy mass. There is no fine detail or line work, just one large smooth blocky form. It reads as a covered, eclipse-like band over the eyes and forehead.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Lin: A single narrow vertical bar running straight down the center of the face, the same width top to bottom with crisp edges. It is a simple, thin, solid stripe with no curves, branches, or other elements. The mark is clean and linear rather than blocky, dividing the face down the middle. Its plainness is the whole design.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Ora: A simple two-part mark stacked vertically and centered, like a large exclamation point. The upper element is a tall rounded vertical bar sitting on the forehead, and below it after a gap is a separate short horizontal block lower on the face. Both pieces are solid, bold, and softly rounded at the corners. The arrangement is symmetric and minimal, reading as a single emphatic vertical accent.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Pan: Three solid filled circles arranged in a vertical column down the center of the face, decreasing in size from top to bottom. The top circle is the largest, the middle one smaller, and the lowest smallest, each separated by a small gap. The dots are bold and rounded with no line work connecting them. The effect is a tidy, symmetric stack of graduated round marks.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_War: Two thick angled dashes, one on each cheek, sloping down and inward toward the nose like a pair of broad brushstroke smears. Each stroke is short, blocky, and slightly tapered, set symmetrically on the left and right with a clear bare gap between them across the center. There is no growth above or below, just the two bold cheek bars. It reads as simple applied war paint streaks.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Wor: Two pairs of short parallel diagonal lines, one pair on each cheek, angled to slope down toward the center of the face. Each side has two thin stacked strokes running in the same direction, mirrored left and right so the marks tilt inward like a furrowed or anxious brow. The lines are fine and linear rather than blocky. The symmetric slanting pairs give a tense, worried expression.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Tig: A bold symmetric body design centered on the chest, built from sweeping curved strokes that flare outward like wings or claw slashes. The upper portion has two large curves rising and splaying to the sides from a central point, and below sits a separate winged shape with pointed prongs curving down and out. The strokes are thick, dynamic, and mirror each other left to right. The overall look is a wild, clawed, animalistic emblem.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_But: Three solid filled circles arranged in a vertical line down the torso, shrinking in size from top to bottom. The largest dot sits highest, a medium dot below it, and the smallest at the bottom, each spaced apart with clear gaps. The circles are bold, round, and plain like a row of buttons running down the front. The arrangement is simple, centered, and symmetric.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Rin: A bold open ring or band design, drawn as a wide oval outline that reads like a hoop encircling the body. The line of the ring is thick at the bottom and thinner across the top, with the interior left open, suggesting a belt or band wrapping around the torso. It tilts slightly in perspective like a circle seen at an angle. The single looping form is the whole design.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Tea: A small solid teardrop shape positioned below the eye on one side of the face, rounded and full at the bottom and tapering to a point at the top like a falling drop. It is a single compact mark set off-center rather than spanning the whole face. The form is simple and blocky with no other elements around it. It reads clearly as a single teardrop tattoo on the cheek.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Hea: A bold X formed by two thick diagonal strokes crossing at the center of the face, like a target or strike-through mark. The two bars meet in the middle and extend out to four blunt ends, roughly symmetric across both diagonals. The strokes are heavy and solid rather than fine. The crossing shape gives a stark, aggressive crosshair or cancellation look.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Lov: A single solid filled heart shape, fairly small and centered, with the two rounded humps at the top and a point at the bottom. The form is bold and blocky with chunky pixel edges rather than a fine outline. It is the only element, sitting alone as one compact symbol. It reads unmistakably as a heart.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Sta: Two solid five-pointed stars sit on the face, arranged diagonally with one star higher to the right and the other lower to the left. Both are bold, filled, blocky shapes with crisp points and no inner detail. The pairing reads as a simple, symmetrical motif scattered across the cheek area. It is a clean and graphic design rather than a fine or linear one.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Hea: A single large, solid heart fills the center of the chest. It has the classic shape with two rounded humps at the top and a point at the bottom, completely filled with no outline or interior detail. The form is bold, blocky, and symmetrical. It is one simple icon centered on the torso.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Cro: A large bold X crosses the torso, formed by two thick diagonal bars meeting at the center. The strokes are heavy and straight, running corner to corner so the design fills the whole area. It is starkly symmetrical and graphic, with no curves or fine detail. The overall impression is a simple, dramatic crossed mark across the chest.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Jes: Two solid wedge shapes face each other across the chest, each like a thick arrowhead or pennant pointing inward toward the center. The pair is mirror symmetric, with a small notch cut into each inner edge so they almost interlock. The forms are bold and blocky with rounded outer edges. Together they suggest a split, pointed collar-like motif spanning the torso.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Moo: A single crescent moon sits on the chest, its solid curved body open on the right side. The shape is thick at the left and tapers to fine points at the top and bottom tips. It is a smooth, clean curve with no inner detail. The motif is simple and asymmetric, reading clearly as a waxing or waning crescent.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Pow: A bold lightning bolt zigzags down the torso, drawn as a single thick jagged stroke. It starts wide at the upper right, bends sharply through the middle, and tapers to a fine point at the lower left. The angular form has crisp diagonal edges and a strong sense of motion. It is one striking, blocky graphic across the chest.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Roy: A solid crown sits across the chest, with three rounded points rising along its top edge and a wider filled base below. The two outer points are capped with small rounded knobs while the center peak stands tallest. The whole shape is filled and blocky with no inner detail. It is a clear, symmetrical regal emblem on the torso.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Win: A pair of spread wings fans across the chest, joined at the center and sweeping upward and outward to pointed tips on each side. The form is solid and filled, with a small downward point at the bottom center where the two halves meet. The silhouette is broad, bold, and symmetric, like a stylized bird or insect in flight. It reads as one strong winged crest spanning the torso.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Sku: Three small skulls are clustered on the chest, two set higher to the left and right and a slightly larger one centered below. Each skull is a rounded filled shape with two dark eye sockets and a small nose hollow punched out. The grouping is roughly symmetric, forming a little triangular arrangement. The design is bold and blocky rather than finely detailed.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Face_Spi: A spider design spans the face, with a heavy central body and two long curved legs sweeping outward and downward to each side. The legs taper to fine points and arc symmetrically like a pair of fangs or mandibles. The shapes are solid and filled with smooth flowing curves. The overall motif is bold and creature-like, draped across the cheeks.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Sca: A long tapering claw-mark sweeps across the chest, thick and rounded at the upper right and narrowing to a fine point trailing down to the lower left. The shape is a single smooth curved gash with a slight split near its lower tail. It is bold, filled, and asymmetric, reading like a deep slash or talon scrape. The motif gives a sense of a torn, raked wound across the torso.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Ske: An oval rib-cage-like motif centers on the chest, drawn as a solid filled ellipse with three curved bands arcing above it on each side. The arcs sit symmetrically over the rounded body like ribs or radiating lines. The forms are bold and blocky with smooth curves. Together they read as a stylized chest or skeletal emblem on the torso.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Spi: A single large downward-pointing spike fills the chest, wide and flat across the top and tapering to a sharp point at the bottom. The shape is a solid filled triangle, like an inverted dagger or shard. Its edges are clean and straight, giving a stark, blocky look. It is one bold, symmetric pointed motif aimed down the torso.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Ins: A bug-like silhouette sits on the chest, with a rounded body, a pair of curved horns or antennae sweeping up and out from the top, and several leg-like prongs splaying down from the bottom. The shape is solid and filled with smooth flowing edges. It is slightly asymmetric, reading as a beetle or stylized insect. The overall design is bold and creature-shaped rather than fine and linear.
LanguageData.RimWorldAccess.StyleDesc.Tattoo_Body_Sun: A bold sun sits on the chest, with a solid round central disc and several straight tapering rays shooting outward to the left and downward. The rays are thick wedges of varying length that fan around the disc, not fully encircling it. The forms are blocky and graphic with crisp edges. The motif reads as a stylized radiant sun, slightly asymmetric in how its rays spread.
